<!-- Tip: Use /create-instructions in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

I use laravel lerd for this project. Hence instead of php artisan command use lerd artisan instead. do the same for composer and npm commands as well. For example, instead of running `php artisan migrate`, run `lerd artisan migrate`. Instead of `composer install`, run `lerd composer install`. Instead of `npm install`, run `lerd npm install`.
